description: Two-state Markov-modulated Poisson process (calm, burst) fitted to the arrival times of the public BurstGPT trace; only the fitted parameters are shipped, not the trace.
method: Hours whose request count lies within a band around the median of the busiest half of the hours are kept (diurnal level changes removed); the Poisson hidden Markov model is fitted by Baum-Welch (EM) to the 10 s counts of each contiguous run of at least 3 kept hours, pooled over runs. Script: fit_burstgpt.py.

used_in_testbed.modulation: shared (one chain per node and device class)
used_in_testbed.note: The fitted rate ratio and mean dwell times are the primary fit rounded; the base rate of each device class is a workload parameter (see ../workload/workload.json) because the trace rate is that of a whole service.
